customer_account_information_change_emai.summary: Email template sent when a customer changes both email and password.
customer_account_information_change_emai.usage: The transactional template used to confirm a combined email-and-password change on the account.

customer_account_information_change_emai.summary: Email template sent when a customer changes their email address.
customer_account_information_change_emai.usage: The transactional template used to confirm an email-address change on the account.

customer_account_information_confirm.summary: Require email confirmation before a new account can sign in.
customer_account_information_confirm.usage: When Yes, new customers must click a confirmation link in an email before they can log in.

customer_account_information_graphql_sha.summary: Expose the customer's group through the GraphQL API.
customer_account_information_graphql_sha.usage: When No, customer group details are withheld from GraphQL responses — useful when group names are commercially sensitive.

customer_account_share_scope.summary: Whether customer accounts are shared across all websites or per website.
customer_account_share_scope.usage: Global lets a customer sign in on any website with one account; Per Website scopes each account to the website where it was created.

customer_address_company_show.summary: Whether the Company field is shown and required.
customer_address_company_show.usage: Controls the Company field on customer and address forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_dob_show.summary: Whether the Date of Birth field is shown and required.
customer_address_dob_show.usage: Controls the Date of Birth field on customer forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_fax_show.summary: Whether the Fax field is shown and required.
customer_address_fax_show.usage: Controls the Fax field on address forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_gender_show.summary: Whether the Gender field is shown and required.
customer_address_gender_show.usage: Controls the Gender field on customer forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_middlename_show.usage: When Yes, a Middle Name/Initial field appears on name forms. It is always optional.

customer_address_prefix_options.usage: Semicolon-separated list of name prefixes offered as a dropdown. Leave empty to show a free-text field instead.

customer_address_prefix_show.summary: Whether the name Prefix field is shown and required.
customer_address_prefix_show.usage: Controls the Prefix field — the title before a name, such as Mr. or Mrs. — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_street_lines.summary: How many street address lines to show (1–4).
customer_address_street_lines.usage: The number of street-address input lines on address forms. Valid range is 1 to 4.

customer_address_suffix_options.usage: Semicolon-separated list of name suffixes offered as a dropdown. Leave empty to show a free-text field instead.

customer_address_suffix_show.summary: Whether the name Suffix field is shown and required.
customer_address_suffix_show.usage: Controls the Suffix field — the part after a name, such as Jr. or Sr. — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_taxvat_show.summary: Whether the Tax/VAT Number field is shown and required.
customer_address_taxvat_show.usage: Controls the Tax/VAT number field on customer and address forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_telephone_show.summary: Whether the Phone Number field is shown and required.
customer_address_telephone_show.usage: Controls the Phone Number field on address forms — optional, required, or hidden.

customer_address_templates_html.summary: The HTML layout used to render a customer address.
customer_address_templates_html.usage: Template that formats addresses in HTML contexts such as account pages and emails. Supports a limited set of tags (b, br, p, strong, …).

customer_address_templates_oneline.summary: The single-line format used to render an address.
customer_address_templates_oneline.usage: Template that renders an address on one line, used in grids and summaries.

customer_address_templates_pdf.summary: The layout used to render addresses in PDF documents.
customer_address_templates_pdf.usage: Template that formats addresses on PDF invoices, shipments and credit memos.

customer_address_templates_text.summary: The plain-text format used to render an address.
customer_address_templates_text.usage: Template that renders an address as plain text, used in plain-text emails.

customer_captcha_case_sensitive.usage: When Yes, the customer must match the letter case of the CAPTCHA exactly.

customer_captcha_enable.summary: Turn on CAPTCHA for storefront customer forms.
customer_captcha_enable.usage: When Yes, a CAPTCHA is shown on the storefront forms selected below.

customer_captcha_failed_attempts_login.summary: Failed logins before CAPTCHA appears on the login form.
customer_captcha_failed_attempts_login.usage: The number of failed attempts after which CAPTCHA is required on login. 0 makes it always show.

customer_captcha_font.summary: The font used to render the CAPTCHA image.
customer_captcha_font.usage: The typeface used when drawing CAPTCHA characters.

customer_captcha_forms.summary: Which storefront forms show a CAPTCHA.
customer_captcha_forms.usage: The customer-facing forms protected by CAPTCHA — login, create account, forgot password, and so on.

customer_captcha_length.summary: How many characters the CAPTCHA contains.
customer_captcha_length.usage: The CAPTCHA length, up to 8 characters. A range such as 3-5 picks a random length each time.

customer_captcha_mode.usage: Whether the CAPTCHA appears on every attempt, or only after a number of failed attempts.

customer_captcha_symbols.summary: The character set CAPTCHAs are drawn from.
customer_captcha_symbols.usage: The pool of characters used to build CAPTCHAs — letters (a–z, A–Z) and digits (0–9).

customer_captcha_timeout.summary: How long a CAPTCHA stays valid (minutes).
customer_captcha_timeout.usage: The number of minutes a generated CAPTCHA remains valid before it must be refreshed.

customer_create_account_auto_group_assig.summary: Assign a customer group automatically from VAT validation.
customer_create_account_auto_group_assig.usage: When Yes, customers are placed into a group automatically based on their VAT number validation result, using the group mappings below.

customer_create_account_confirm.summary: Require email confirmation for newly created accounts.
customer_create_account_confirm.usage: When Yes, new accounts must be confirmed through an emailed link before the customer can sign in.

customer_create_account_default_group.summary: The customer group new accounts are assigned to.
customer_create_account_default_group.usage: The default group applied to newly created customer accounts.

customer_create_account_email_confirmati.summary: Email template asking a new customer to confirm their account.
customer_create_account_email_confirmati.usage: The transactional template that carries the account-confirmation link.

customer_create_account_email_confirmed_.summary: Email template sent once an account is confirmed.
customer_create_account_email_confirmed_.usage: Sent instead of the welcome email after a customer confirms their account.

customer_create_account_email_domain.summary: Default domain for the sender of new-account emails.
customer_create_account_email_domain.usage: The email domain used in the from-address of account emails — typically the store's domain.

customer_create_account_email_identity.summary: The store identity new-account emails are sent from.
customer_create_account_email_identity.usage: Which store email identity (sender) is used for account-creation emails.

customer_create_account_email_no_passwor.summary: Welcome email for accounts created without a password.
customer_create_account_email_no_passwor.usage: Sent instead of the default welcome email when an account is created without a password, so the customer can set one via the link.

customer_create_account_email_required_c.summary: Require an email address when creating an order in the admin.
customer_create_account_email_required_c.usage: When Yes, the Email field is mandatory while an admin creates an order.

customer_create_account_email_template.summary: The welcome email template for new accounts.
customer_create_account_email_template.usage: The default transactional template sent when a customer account is created.

customer_create_account_generate_human_f.usage: When Yes, customers receive human-friendly sequential IDs rather than raw entity IDs.

customer_create_account_tax_calculation_.summary: Which address is used for VAT validation at registration.
customer_create_account_tax_calculation_.usage: Whether the billing or the shipping address is used when validating a customer's VAT number and assigning a group.

customer_create_account_vat_frontend_vis.summary: Show the VAT Number field on the storefront.
customer_create_account_vat_frontend_vis.usage: When Yes, customers can enter a VAT number on account and address forms.

customer_create_account_viv_disable_auto.summary: Disable automatic VAT-based group assignment by default.
customer_create_account_viv_disable_auto.usage: When Yes, automatic group assignment from VAT validation is off unless explicitly enabled.

customer_create_account_viv_domestic_gro.summary: Group for customers with a valid domestic VAT ID.
customer_create_account_viv_domestic_gro.usage: The group assigned when a customer's VAT number is valid and from the store's own country.

customer_create_account_viv_error_group.summary: Group used when VAT validation cannot be completed.
customer_create_account_viv_error_group.usage: The group assigned when the VAT validation service is unavailable or returns an error.

customer_create_account_viv_intra_union_.summary: Group for customers with a valid intra-EU VAT ID.
customer_create_account_viv_intra_union_.usage: The group assigned when a customer's VAT number is valid and from another EU country.

customer_create_account_viv_invalid_grou.summary: Group for customers whose VAT ID is invalid.
customer_create_account_viv_invalid_grou.usage: The group assigned when a customer's VAT number fails validation.

customer_create_account_viv_on_each_tran.summary: Re-validate VAT on every order, not just at registration.
customer_create_account_viv_on_each_tran.usage: When Yes, the customer's VAT number is re-checked on each transaction and their group updated accordingly.

customer_online_customers_online_minutes.summary: How long a customer counts as "online" (minutes).
customer_online_customers_online_minutes.usage: The window during which a customer is considered online after their last activity. Leave empty for the default of 15 minutes.

customer_online_customers_section_data_l.summary: How long private customer section data is cached (minutes).
customer_online_customers_section_data_l.usage: The lifetime, in minutes, of the private customer-section data cached in the browser (cart, account state).

customer_password_autocomplete_on_storef.summary: Allow browser autocomplete on storefront password fields.
customer_password_autocomplete_on_storef.usage: When Yes, browsers may autofill login and password fields on the storefront.

customer_password_forgot_email_identity.summary: The store identity password-reset emails are sent from.
customer_password_forgot_email_identity.usage: Which store email identity (sender) is used for forgot-password emails.

customer_password_forgot_email_template.summary: The email template for forgot-password requests.
customer_password_forgot_email_template.usage: The transactional template carrying the password-reset link.

customer_password_lockout_failures.summary: Failed logins before an account is locked.
customer_password_lockout_failures.usage: The number of consecutive failed logins that locks a customer account. Use 0 to disable locking.

customer_password_lockout_threshold.summary: How long a locked account stays locked (minutes).
customer_password_lockout_threshold.usage: The time, in minutes, after which a locked account is automatically unlocked.

customer_password_max_number_password_re.summary: Maximum password-reset requests allowed per hour.
customer_password_max_number_password_re.usage: Caps how many reset requests one account or IP can make each hour. Use 0 to disable the limit.

customer_password_min_time_between_passw.usage: The enforced wait between consecutive reset requests. Use 0 to disable.

customer_password_minimum_password_lengt.summary: Minimum number of characters in a customer password.
customer_password_minimum_password_lengt.usage: The shortest password a customer may set. Must be 1 or greater.

customer_password_password_reset_protect.usage: Whether reset-request limits are tracked by IP, by email, by both, or not enforced at all.

customer_password_remind_email_template.summary: The email template for password reminders.
customer_password_remind_email_template.usage: The transactional template used to remind a customer of their password.

customer_password_required_character_cla.summary: How many character types a password must include.
customer_password_required_character_cla.usage: The number of distinct character classes — lowercase, uppercase, digits, special — a password must contain.

customer_password_reset_link_expiration_.summary: How long a password-reset link stays valid (hours).
customer_password_reset_link_expiration_.usage: The lifetime of a reset link before it expires. Must be 1 or greater.

customer_password_reset_password_templat.summary: The email template confirming a password reset.
customer_password_reset_password_templat.usage: The transactional template sent to confirm a successful password reset.

customer_startup_redirect_dashboard.summary: Send customers to their dashboard right after login.
customer_startup_redirect_dashboard.usage: When Yes, customers land on their account dashboard after signing in. When No, they stay on the page they were on.
